"""Independently freeze the actual alpha resize, encoded pixels and regression evidence."""
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,io,json,math,re,shutil,subprocess,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageSequence
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];runtime=root/'product/.runtime';public=root/'docs/assets/alpha-resize-20261016';dest=root/'docs/validation/evidence'
def load(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def decode(p,channels=3):
 r=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-i',str(p),'-map','0:v:0','-an','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgba' if channels==4 else 'rgb24','pipe:1'],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=120)
 return np.frombuffer(r.stdout,np.uint8).reshape(-1,288,512,channels)
evidence=load(public/'evidence.json')
archive=subprocess.run(['git','-c','core.autocrlf=false','archive','--format=zip',evidence['baseline_ref'],'product/src'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
baseline_files={}
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as package:
 for entry in package.infolist():
  if entry.is_dir():continue
  expected=package.read(entry);digest='sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest();baseline_files[entry.filename]=digest
  for checkout in [runtime/'alpha-resampling-baseline',runtime/'alpha-resample-public-20261016-v3/baseline']:
   assert (checkout/entry.filename).read_bytes()==expected,(str(checkout),entry.filename)
assert sha(root/'scripts/smoke_alpha_resampling.py')==evidence['script_sha256']
assert sha(root/'product/src/ai_ad_editor/render.py')==evidence['current_render_sha256']
for name,digest in evidence['file_sha256'].items():assert sha(public/name)==digest,name
assert len(evidence['cli_calls'])==10 and all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in evidence['cli_calls'])
render_calls=[c for c in evidence['cli_calls'] if c['argv'][0]=='render']
assert len(render_calls)==4 and sum(c['baseline'] for c in render_calls)==2 and all('--publish' in c['argv'] for c in render_calls)
black=np.asarray(Image.open(public/'marker-black.png').convert('RGBA'));green=np.asarray(Image.open(public/'marker-green.png').convert('RGBA'))
assert np.array_equal(black[:,:,3],green[:,:,3])
nonzero=black[:,:,3]>0;assert np.array_equal(black[nonzero,:3],green[nonzero,:3])
assert not np.array_equal(black[~nonzero,:3],green[~nonzero,:3])
independent={}
for prefix in ['before','after']:
 a=decode(public/f'{prefix}-black.mp4');b=decode(public/f'{prefix}-green.mp4');assert len(a)==len(b)==32
 diff=np.abs(a.astype(np.int16)-b.astype(np.int16));value={'frames':32,'maximum_rgb_difference':int(diff.max()),'changed_rgb_components':int(np.count_nonzero(diff)),'mean_absolute_rgb_difference':float(diff.mean())}
 assert value==evidence['hidden_rgb_invariance'][prefix]
 independent[prefix]=value
with Image.open(public/'alpha-resampling-comparison.gif') as gif:
 durations=[f.info['duration'] for f in ImageSequence.Iterator(gif)]
assert durations==evidence['gif']['durations_ms'] and sum(durations)==4000 and len(durations)==32
media_probe={}
for name in evidence['probes']:
 r=subprocess.run(['ffprobe','-v','error','-count_frames','-show_entries','stream=codec_type,codec_name,width,height,avg_frame_rate,nb_read_frames,duration','-of','json',str(public/name)],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=90)
 streams=json.loads(r.stdout)['streams'];video=next(s for s in streams if s['codec_type']=='video');audio=[s for s in streams if s['codec_type']=='audio']
 assert int(video['nb_read_frames'])==32 and video['avg_frame_rate']=='8/1' and float(video['duration'])==4.
 assert (len(audio)==1 and audio[0]['codec_name']=='aac') if name.startswith(('before-','after-')) else not audio
 media_probe[name]=streams
natural_work=runtime/'mask-track-natural-20261016';project=natural_work/'project'
value=load(project/'project.json');assets={a['id']:a for a in value['assets']};natural=load(natural_work/'after-premultiplied-resize.json');previous=load(natural_work/'after-alpha-fix.json')
assert sha(project/assets['source']['uri'])==natural['source_sha256']==natural['source_sha256_current']
assert sha(project/assets['corrected_mask']['uri'])==natural['mask_sha256']==natural['mask_sha256_current']
actual_output=project/'renders/internal-bound-premultiplied.mp4';assert sha(actual_output)==natural['output_sha256']
mask=decode(project/assets['corrected_mask']['uri'],4);source=decode(project/assets['source']['uri']);encoded=decode(actual_output)
assert len(mask)==len(source)==len(encoded)==32
rows=[]
tracking=load(project/'validation/structural-only-binding.json')['plan']['tracking']['frames']
for i in range(32):
 y,x=np.nonzero(mask[i,:,:,3]>127);center=[float((x.min()+x.max()+1)/2),float((y.min()+y.max()+1)/2)]
 image=encoded[i];selected=(image[:,:,0]>180)&(image[:,:,1]<95)&(image[:,:,2]>165)
 selected&=np.max(np.abs(image.astype(np.int16)-source[i].astype(np.int16)),axis=2)>65
 yy,xx=np.indices(selected.shape);selected&=(abs(xx-center[0])<20)&(abs(yy-center[1])<20)
 y,x=np.nonzero(selected);observed=[float(x.mean()),float(y.mean())];error=math.dist(center,observed)
 recorded=natural['marker_measurement']['rows'][i]
 assert abs(tracking[i]['x']*512-center[0])<1e-7 and abs(tracking[i]['y']*288-center[1])<1e-7
 assert center==recorded['mask_bbox_center'] and observed==recorded['rendered_marker_center'] and abs(error-recorded['error_pixels'])<1e-12
 rows.append({'frame':i,'mask_bbox_center':center,'rendered_marker_center':observed,'error_pixels':error,'selected_marker_pixels':len(x)})
assert max(r['error_pixels'] for r in rows)==natural['marker_measurement']['max_error_pixels']
assert natural['new_inference_runs']==0 and not natural['natural_segmentation_quality_accepted']
assert natural['marker_measurement']['tolerance_pixels']==previous['marker_measurement']['tolerance_pixels']==3.
assert len(natural['semantic_mask_checks_still_failed']['failed'])==1
full=load(runtime/'alpha-resampling-full-20261016.json');targeted=load(runtime/'alpha-resampling-targeted-20261016.json');before=load(runtime/'alpha-resampling-before-20261016.json')
assert full['status']=='passed' and full['test_count']==411 and full['source_file_count']==86
for record in [full,targeted,before]:
 assert record['source_sha256_before']==record['source_sha256_after']
 for name,digest in record['source_sha256_after'].items():assert sha(root/name)==digest,name
assert targeted['test_count']==before['test_count']==6 and targeted['status']=='passed'
assert before['exit_code']==1 and re.search(r'FAILED \(failures=6\)',(runtime/'alpha-resampling-before-20261016.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
logs={}
for mode,record in [('full',full),('targeted',targeted),('before',before)]:
 name=f'alpha-resampling-{mode}-20261016.log';assert sha(runtime/name)==record['log_sha256'];shutil.copy2(runtime/name,dest/name);logs[name]={'sha256':sha(dest/name),'bytes':(dest/name).stat().st_size}
fixture_logs={}
for p in sorted(runtime.glob('alpha-resampling-fixture-*-20261016.log')):fixture_logs[p.name]={'sha256':sha(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'public_log':False,'counted_as_product_failure':False}
record={'checked_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Actual native CLI outputs and independent encoded frame checks; controlled resize and one existing natural sample; not full Jianying parity',
 'product_regression':full,'new_targeted_subset':targeted,'old_source_same_tests_failed':before,'logs':logs,'early_fixture_errors':fixture_logs,
 'baseline_executed_source_files_verified_against_git_archive':baseline_files,
 'public_evidence_path':public.relative_to(root).as_posix()+'/evidence.json','public_evidence_sha256':sha(public/'evidence.json'),
 'public_independent_hidden_rgb_invariance':independent,'public_input_alpha_and_visible_rgb_identical':True,'public_cli_calls':10,'public_render_publish_calls':4,
 'public_independent_media_probe':media_probe,
 'visual_review':{'public_contact_frames':[16],'natural_private_contact_frames':[22,27,30],'method':'Static view_image inspection of actual decoded output crops; no continuous playback','continuous_playback_reviewed':False,'audio_reviewed':False},
 'natural_internal_sample':natural,'natural_independent_pixel_rows':rows,'natural_previous_failed_measurement':previous['marker_measurement'],
 'natural_old_failure_retained':True,'natural_media_published':False,'natural_marker_original_3px_gate_passed':True,'natural_semantic_mask_accepted':False,'new_model_inferences':0,
 'diagnostic_sampling_variants':{'scope':'Private preliminary filter-graph experiments, not formal CLI/product test passes','results':load(natural_work/'sampling-experiments.json')},
 'quality_limits':['No affine/dynamic-size-crop alpha resampling acceptance','No linear-light or full HDR acceptance','No 1080p/4K throughput or total memory acceptance','Original wrist checkpoint still fails','No complete natural visual/audio or Jianying parity acceptance'],
 'helper_sha256':{p.relative_to(root).as_posix():sha(p) for p in [Path(__file__),runtime/'verify_alpha_resampling_20261016.py',runtime/'check_mask_tracking_natural_premult_20261016.py',root/'scripts/smoke_alpha_resampling.py']},
 'collector_source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),'skills_audit_sha256':sha(dest/'skills-audit-alpha-resampling-20261016.json')}
(dest/'alpha-resampling-20261016.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'tests':full['test_count'],'product_sources':full['source_file_count'],'public_difference_before':independent['before']['maximum_rgb_difference'],'public_difference_after':independent['after']['maximum_rgb_difference'],'natural_max_error':natural['marker_measurement']['max_error_pixels'],'natural_segmentation_accepted':False},ensure_ascii=False))
